status: proposed only; not target-configured or compiled

runtime_requirements.compositing: verify acceleratedCompositingEnabled=false, forceCompositingMode=false, and selected NonCompositedFrameRenderer
runtime_requirements.buffer_transport: CPU raster/SHM only; verify no GL/GPU/DMABuf path
runtime_requirements.network_policy: bundled document/resources only; no external requests
runtime_requirements.platform_registration: custom statically registered SrvrOS WPEPlatform implementation; not implemented
runtime_requirements.frame_completion: Unresolved owner design: value0 native RELEASE can mean published or discarded and is consumed internally. Need non-consuming observation, explicit outcomes and accepted-frame cancellation; no second GUI reader.
runtime_requirements.engine_retirement: Rendered/FrameDone, released/ReleaseBuffer, and local GObject retirement are distinct exact-once operations per accepted submission. A GObject unref sends neither engine message.
runtime_requirements.geometry: Initial logical page viewport640x480 excluding chrome, conditional on actual CONFIGURE scale1 and sufficient canvas; explicitly refuse scale2 or insufficient admission geometry.
runtime_requirements.dirty_and_present: Engine repaint marks UI dirty. Canvas1 admits writes; present0 is send retry,1 queued commit,-1 failure. RETRY+CONFIGURE must retire the old submission without repainting a new generation.
runtime_requirements.glib_gui_wait: Native GUI wait admits at most8 pipe/PTY FDs with <=1s horizon; synthetic eventfd uses libc poll10ms slices. A general GPollFD set needs an admissible bridge or bounded nonblocking/fallback policy, honest unsupported interests and no busy loop.
